title: SmartEmbedAgent Configuration Schema
description: Top-level configuration for the SmartEmbedAgent. Validates user-provided JSON against documented field names, types, ranges, and enum values.

pii_settings.description: Controls how PII is detected and redacted from the corpus.

custom_redaction_list.description: Strings or regex patterns the user wants force-redacted regardless of detection confidence (e.g. internal codenames, project names).

whitelist.description: Strings exempt from redaction even if NER or regex flags them. Useful for company names, public figures referenced in policy documents, or terminology NER misclassifies.

redaction_aggressiveness.description: How aggressively to redact: 'low' = regex only, 'medium' = regex + NER PERSON/LOCATION/ORG, 'high' = medium + ORG + MISC entities + stricter phone/email matching.

ner_model_choice.description: Hugging Face model identifier for the NER step. Default: 'dslim/bert-base-NER'.

recognizer.description: Recognizer backend. 'legacy' (default) is the regex + dslim NER pipeline. 'presidio' uses Microsoft Presidio (50+ entity types, validated detection, confidence scores). Falls back to legacy with a warning if presidio isn't installed.

region_packs.description: Optional region-specific recognizer packs. Currently supported: 'india' (Aadhaar with Verhoeff validation, PAN, Indian mobile, vehicle registration). Apply to both backends.

model_preferences.description: User constraints and preferences on the recommended embedding model.

max_model_size_gb.description: Maximum allowed model size in gigabytes (on-disk weights). Models larger than this are filtered from the candidate pool.

preferred_model_families.description: Ordered list of preferred providers / families, e.g. 'sentence-transformers', 'BAAI', 'mistral', 'qwen', 'openai'. Earlier entries are preferred over later.

prioritize_speed_over_accuracy.description: If true, the agent biases toward smaller, faster models even when a larger model would score higher on retrieval benchmarks.

target_use_case.description: Primary downstream task, used to pick task-tuned models when available.

hardware_constraints.description: Caps that override what the device profiler discovers. Use these when you want to run on a host but reserve resources for other workloads.

max_vram_usage_gb.description: Maximum VRAM the agent may assume is available, in GB. Use 0 to forbid GPU usage.

max_ram_usage_gb.description: Maximum system RAM the agent may assume is available, in GB.

allow_gpu.description: If false, no GPU model will be recommended even if one is detected.

fallback_to_cpu.description: If GPU is unavailable or insufficient, fall back to CPU-only models. Recommended true.

agent_settings.description: Runtime behavior of the orchestrator agent.

enable_web_search.description: Allow the agent to query the web for current best practices and benchmarks.

search_cache_days.description: Search cache TTL in days. Cached entries older than this are re-fetched.

llm_model.description: Identifier of the LLM that drives the agent's reasoning step (e.g. 'claude-sonnet-4-6').

verbose_logging.description: If true, the agent prints its tool-calling trace to stdout.
